description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Gilgamesh)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Gilgamesh)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00, casts Dual Ironfire after using equipped Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Gilgamesh)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Gilgamesh)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Gilgamesh)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00, casts Dual Flame Slash after using Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Flame Slash
description.text: 4/6/10 single attacks (0.41 each) after 1/2/3+ uses, 100% additional critical chance, 100% hit rate, grants [Retaliate] to the user

description.name: Retaliate
description.text: Evades PHY attacks, counters PHY attacks with Attack

description.name: Dual Ironfire
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)], grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] to all allies every third cast

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
